keywords: wedge anchors, wedge anchor vs sleeve anchor, M10 wedge anchor, stainless wedge anchor, wedge anchor embedment depth, wedge anchor load chart, wedge anchor drill size, wedge anchors for base plates, wedge anchor installation
author: TradeGo Fasteners Technical Team

body.en: Wedge anchors lock inside solid concrete through controlled mechanical expansion rather than friction along a full sleeve like a sleeve anchor. Each anchor consists of a threaded stud, a tapered clip near the tip, a hex nut, and a washer. First, drill a hole matching the nominal anchor diameter, such as an M10 wedge anchor in a 10 mm hole, and reach the required wedge anchor embedment depth before cleaning out dust so expansion occurs in intact base material. Second, insert the anchor through the fixture or set it flush and tighten the hex nut with a calibrated torque wrench. As the stud pulls upward during tightening, the cone at the bottom rides inside the split expansion clip, forcing the clip outward against the concrete borehole wall. Unlike a sleeve anchor that expands along a tubular shell near the surface, a wedge anchor concentrates radial locking force deeper in sound concrete, which explains why buyers check a wedge anchor load chart before specifying fixtures. For coastal or humid routes across Southern and East Africa, such as shipments arriving through Beira or Durban for projects in Zimbabwe, carbon steel with zinc plating suits dry indoor loads while 304 or 316 stainless wedge anchor options resist chloride and moisture corrosion. Typical industry values for effective embedment depth on an M10 anchor often sit around 40 mm to 50 mm depending on design and standards such as ASTM F1554 or European anchors referenced under EN 1992-4.
body.zh: 楔形锚栓通过在实心混凝土内部产生受控的机械膨胀实现锁紧，而不是像套筒锚栓那样依靠整个套筒壁的摩擦力。每支锚栓通常由带螺纹的螺杆、靠近尾端的锥形夹片、六角螺母和垫圈组成。第一步，钻出与公称锚栓直径匹配的孔洞，例如在10毫米孔径中使用M10楔形锚栓，并达到规定的楔形锚栓埋深后清理粉尘，确保膨胀发生在完好的基材中。第二步，将锚栓穿过固定件安装或与表面齐平放置，并用校准扭矩扳手拧紧六角螺母。拧紧时螺杆向上受拉，底部的锥体在分体式膨胀夹片内移动，将夹片向外撑紧在混凝土孔壁上。与在靠近表面处通过管状外壳膨胀的套筒锚栓不同，楔形锚栓将径向锁紧力集中在更深的完好混凝土中，这也是采购方在确定固定件前会查阅楔形锚栓荷载表的原因。对于经由贝拉港或德班港运往津巴布韦等南部和东部非洲沿海或潮湿路线项目的货物，镀锌碳钢适用于干燥室内荷载，而304或316不锈钢楔形锚栓则可抵抗氯化物和潮湿腐蚀。以常见行业典型值为例，M10锚栓的有效埋深通常在40毫米至50毫米左右，具体取决于设计及ASTM F1554或EN 1992-4所涉及的欧标锚固等相关标准。

body.en: Selecting the right wedge anchors starts with matching anchor diameter, thread size, and embedment depth to base material thickness and load direction. For light-to-medium fixtures like brackets and racking, an M10 wedge anchor or M12 wedge anchor is common, while heavy structural baseplates often require M16 or M20 sizes. Compare a wedge anchor vs sleeve anchor carefully: wedge anchors suit solid uncracked or cracked concrete where high expansion force holds firm, whereas sleeve anchors fit hollow block or brick where wider radial expansion reduces splitting risk. Follow a clear selection sequence. First, confirm concrete compressive strength and ensure base thickness exceeds embedment depth plus clearance, with a typical industry value for minimum effective embedment around four to six times anchor diameter. Second, check fixture thickness to select adequate thread length and overall anchor length so the nut engages cleanly without bottoming out. Third, review a wedge anchor load chart from your manufacturer for tension and shear values, applying safety factors required by local engineering practice and standards such as EN 1992-4, ASTM E488, or ISO 898-1 mechanical property classes. Fourth, choose stainless wedge anchor grades like A4 or 316 stainless steel for coastal port air near Durban or Beira or wet industrial plants in southern Africa, or hot-dip galvanized carbon steel for sheltered indoor work. Confirming wedge anchor embedment depth and material grade early helps buyers ordering from a wedge anchor supplier China avoid site delays and mismatched fasteners.
body.zh: 选楔形锚栓首先要将锚栓直径、螺纹规格和埋入深度匹配基材厚度与荷载方向。轻至中等荷载如支架和货架常用M10或M12楔形锚栓，重型结构底板常需M16或M20规格。对比楔形锚栓与套筒锚栓：楔形锚栓适于高膨胀力稳固持荷的实心未开裂或已开裂混凝土，套筒锚栓则适于空心砌块或砖墙，较大径向膨胀可降低开裂风险。请按步骤选型。一、确认混凝土抗压强度，确保基材厚度大于埋入深度加余量，最小有效埋入深度的典型行业值约为锚栓直径的四至六倍。二、核查固定件厚度以选定足够螺纹长度与总长，使螺母顺畅紧固不触底。三、查阅制造商楔形锚栓荷载表获取拉拔与剪切值，并按EN 1992-4、ASTM E488或ISO 898-1机械性能等级及当地工程惯例应用安全系数。四、德班或贝拉沿海港口空气或南部非洲潮湿厂房可选A4或316不锈钢锚栓，室内遮蔽环境可选热浸镀锌碳钢。尽早确认埋入深度和材质等级，可助向中国楔形锚栓供应商采购的买家避免工地延误与紧固件不匹配。

heading.zh: 混凝土等级与开裂混凝土限制

body.en: When specifying wedge anchors for structural or heavy-duty fastening, concrete compressive strength and cracking state directly govern holding capacity. Standard design tables often reference uncracked concrete at 20 MPa to 30 MPa, which is a typical industry value for general slabs, whereas lower-strength or poorly cured concrete reduces pull-out resistance sharply. In cracked concrete, tensile stress opens micro-cracks that weaken friction along the expansion clip, so select anchors evaluated for cracked concrete under EN 1992-4 or ASTM E488 rather than relying on an uncracked wedge anchor load chart. For high-load or damp industrial sites along the coast or in Zimbabwe, pair A4 or 316 stainless wedge anchors with grade-matched nuts and washers to prevent galvanic and atmospheric corrosion. Follow this step-by-step selection check before ordering. First, confirm the site concrete grade and check whether tensile cracking is expected near the fixture. Second, choose anchor diameter and minimum embedment depth, such as an M10 wedge anchor set to a typical industry value of 40 mm to 50 mm embedment for light-to-medium loads, or deeper sizes for heavy brackets. Third, compare wedge anchors against sleeve anchors, using wedge anchors for solid structural concrete and sleeve anchors only where light masonry or hollow blocks apply. Finally, apply safety factors and edge-distance rules from ISO 898-1 or applicable local codes, and confirm export packing for transit through Beira or Durban.
body.zh: 在为结构或重型紧固选用楔形锚栓时，混凝土抗压强度与开裂状态直接决定承载力。标准设计表通常以20兆帕至30兆帕的无裂纹混凝土为参考，这是普通楼板的典型行业数值，而强度偏低或养护不足的混凝土会大幅降低拔出阻力。在开裂混凝土中，拉应力会使微裂缝张开，削弱膨胀夹片沿孔壁的摩擦力，因此应选用依据EN 1992-4或ASTM E488针对开裂混凝土评估的锚栓，而不能仅依赖无裂纹楔形锚栓载荷表。对于沿海或津巴布韦等高载荷或潮湿工业现场，可将A4或316不锈钢楔形锚栓与同级螺母和垫圈搭配使用，以防止电偶腐蚀和大气腐蚀。下单前请按以下步骤核对选型。第一步，确认现场混凝土等级并检查固定件附近是否可能出现受拉裂缝。第二步，确定锚栓直径与最小锚固深度，例如轻至中等载荷下将M10楔形锚栓设定在40毫米至50毫米这一典型行业数值的锚固深度，重型支架则选用更深规格。第三步，对比楔形锚栓与套筒锚栓，实心结构混凝土用楔形锚栓，仅在轻质砌体或空心砌块适用处使用套筒锚栓。最后，按ISO 898-1或适用的当地规范应用安全系数与边距规则，并确认经贝拉港或德班港中转的出口包装。

heading.en: Stainless vs Zinc for Coastal Sites
heading.zh: 沿海工地的不锈钢与镀锌膨胀锚栓选型

body.en: Choosing between stainless steel and zinc coated wedge anchors for coastal sites depends on salt spray exposure, service life, and concrete condition. For M10 wedge anchors and M12 wedge anchors used near ports such as Durban or Beira, airborne chlorides quickly attack thin electroplated zinc coatings, causing rust staining and expansion clip seizure. Zinc coated carbon steel wedge anchors, following typical industry values around five to fifteen microns for electroplating or forty-five to eighty-five microns for hot-dip galvanizing, suit dry indoor concrete or inland projects in Zimbabwe away from marine spray. For exposed coastal piers, desalination lines, and seaside brackets, austenitic stainless steel wedge anchors in A4 or 316 grade resist pitting better than A2 or 304 steel. To select and install wedge anchors step by step, first check the project specification and wedge anchor load chart for concrete grade and edge distance. Second, match steel grade and thread standard such as ISO metric coarse threads with appropriate nuts and washers. Third, drill a clean hole to the required diameter and wedge anchor embedment depth, blow out dust, and set the anchor with a hammer before torquing the nut. Remember that stainless steel threads can gall during tightening without anti-seize, whereas zinc or stainless wedge anchors must not be mixed with incompatible metals in wet zones. Specify clearly when ordering from a wedge anchor supplier China so packing and grades match site conditions.
body.zh: 在沿海工地选用不锈钢还是镀锌膨胀锚栓，取决于盐雾暴露程度、使用寿命和混凝土状况。对于德班或贝拉等港口附近使用的M10和M12膨胀锚栓，空气中的氯化物会迅速侵蚀较薄的电镀锌层，导致锈蚀渗出和膨胀夹片卡滞。按典型行业数值，电镀锌约5至15微米，热浸镀锌约45至85微米，这类镀锌碳钢膨胀锚栓适合干燥室内混凝土或远离海洋盐雾的津巴布韦内陆项目。对于沿海码头、海水淡化管线和海边支架，A4或316级奥氏体不锈钢膨胀锚栓比A2或304钢更能抗点蚀。按步骤选型和安装膨胀锚栓时，第一步查阅项目规范与膨胀锚栓载荷表，确认混凝土强度等级和边距。第二步核对钢材牌号与ISO公制粗牙等螺纹标准，并匹配合适的螺母和垫圈。第三步按要求直径和膨胀锚栓埋入深度钻净孔，吹净粉尘，用锤击入锚栓后再拧紧螺母。注意无防卡咬剂时不锈钢螺纹紧固易发生咬死，且潮湿区切勿混用不兼容金属的镀锌或不锈钢膨胀锚栓。向中国膨胀锚栓供应商下单时请明确说明，确保包装和等级符合工地条件。

body.en: Start by marking the anchor position on uncracked concrete and verifying minimum edge and spacing distances for an M10 wedge anchor. Drill a perpendicular hole with a rotary hammer and carbide bit matching the anchor diameter, for example a 10 mm bit for M10 wedge anchors, down to at least the required embedment depth plus a typical industry value of 10 mm to 15 mm for concrete dust clearance. Clean the bore thoroughly using compressed air and a wire brush so loose dust does not reduce expansion grip or published load chart values. Unlike a sleeve anchor, a wedge anchor relies on a clip expanding against the hole wall near the bottom, so clean bore walls and accurate embedment depth are essential. Tap the wedge anchor through the fixture using a hammer until the washer seats against the fixture or concrete surface. With a calibrated torque wrench, tighten the nut to the manufacturer specification, a typical industry value being 30 Nm to 40 Nm for M10 carbon steel wedge anchors, drawing the cone upward so the clip locks firmly. For stainless wedge anchors in coastal or high-humidity sites shipped via Durban or Beira to Zimbabwe, apply anti-seize where appropriate to prevent galling during tightening. Avoid over-torquing, which can strip threads or spall concrete near the surface. Follow project drawings aligned with EN, ISO, or ASTM anchoring practice and verify final nut tightness before loading.
body.zh: 首先在未开裂混凝土上标记锚栓位置，并核查M10胀锚螺栓的最小边距与间距。使用电锤和硬质合金钻头钻出与锚栓直径匹配的垂直孔，例如M10胀锚螺栓配10毫米钻头，深度至少达到要求的锚固深度，再加上典型行业数值10毫米至15毫米的混凝土粉尘余量。用压缩空气和钢丝刷彻底清理孔壁，防止松散粉尘削弱膨胀握裹力或降低已发布载荷表数值。与套管式锚栓不同，胀锚螺栓依靠膨胀夹片在孔底附近向孔壁撑开，因此洁净孔壁与准确锚固深度至关重要。用锤子将胀锚螺栓穿入被固定件敲击到位，使垫圈贴合被固定件或混凝土表面。使用经校准的扭矩扳手按制造商规范拧紧螺母，M10碳钢胀锚螺栓的典型行业数值为30牛米至40牛米，从而拉动锥体上移使夹片牢牢锁紧。对于经德班或贝拉运往津巴布韦、用于沿海或高湿工地的不锈钢胀锚螺栓，应在适当部位涂抹防咬合剂，防止拧紧时发生咬死。切勿过度拧紧，以免滑丝或导致表面附近混凝土崩裂。遵循符合EN、ISO或ASTM锚固规范的施工图纸，并在施加荷载前复核螺母最终紧固度。

heading.en: Reading Load Charts and Safety Factors
heading.zh: 解读载荷表与安全系数

body.en: A wedge anchor load chart lists tensile pull-out and shear capacities by thread diameter, embedment depth, and concrete compressive strength, typically under EN, ASTM, or ISO test frameworks. First, confirm whether values represent ultimate failure loads or working loads, and check concrete condition such as uncracked versus cracked concrete. Second, match anchor size and embedment depth to your fixture load; for example, an M10 wedge anchor in normal concrete often delivers a typical industry value around 600 to 800 lbs allowable tension or roughly 1,000 lbs allowable shear depending on embedment depth and grade. Third, divide ultimate test loads by a safety factor to establish working limits; a 4:1 safety factor is a typical industry value for static loads, while higher factors apply to overhead, dynamic, or seismic service. Fourth, apply reduction factors when anchors sit close to concrete edges, sit near neighboring anchors, or face combined tension and shear. Compared with a sleeve anchor, which expands along a tubular sleeve and suits lighter masonry or hollow substrates, a wedge anchor concentrates expansion near the tip for solid concrete. Where moisture or coastal air near Durban or Beira threatens carbon steel, specify stainless wedge anchors such as A4 or 316 stainless steel rather than plain carbon steel. Always have a qualified structural engineer verify project loads, local codes, and material grades before ordering from a wedge anchor supplier in China.
body.zh: 楔形锚栓载荷表通常依据EN、ASTM或ISO测试体系，按螺纹直径、埋入深度和混凝土抗压强度列出抗拉拔力与抗剪承载力。首先，确认数值代表极限破坏载荷还是许用工作载荷，并核查混凝土状态，例如开裂混凝土或非开裂混凝土。其次，根据构件载荷匹配锚栓规格与埋入深度；例如在普通混凝土中，M10楔形锚栓的许用抗拉承载力典型行业值约为600至800磅，许用抗剪承载力约为1,000磅，具体取决于埋入深度与材质等级。第三，将极限测试载荷除以安全系数以确定工作限值；静态载荷通常采用4:1的安全系数，属于典型行业值，而悬吊、动载荷或抗震工况需采用更高系数。第四，当锚栓靠近混凝土边缘、相邻锚栓间距较近或承受拉剪复合受力时，须应用折减系数。与沿管状套筒膨胀、更适用于较轻砌体或空心基材的套筒锚栓相比，楔形锚栓将膨胀集中在底部锥体处，更适合实心混凝土。在德班或贝拉等靠近沿海潮湿空气、碳钢易受腐蚀的区域，建议选用A4或316不锈钢楔形锚栓，而非普通碳钢。向中国楔形锚栓供应商下单前，请务必由具备资质的结构工程师核实项目载荷、当地规范及材质等级。

heading.zh: 包装、起订量与出口单据

body.en: For buyers sourcing wedge anchors from a wedge anchor supplier in China for Southern and East African projects, proper packing, minimum order quantities, and export paperwork prevent transit damage and customs delays. Standard sizes such as M10 wedge anchor and M12 wedge anchor are commonly packed in inner color boxes or polybags inside double-wall corrugated cartons, then secured on fumigated or heat-treated ISPM 15 wooden pallets with stretch film and strapping. Heavy sea routes into Durban, Beira, and Mombasa benefit from moisture-barrier liners and pallet corner guards, especially for carbon steel and stainless wedge anchor orders facing coastal humidity or inland hauls toward Zimbabwe and Zambia. As a typical industry value, MOQs often start around 500 to 2,000 pieces per size and finish, with mixed-size container consolidation available on full container loads. Before vessel booking, follow a clear export step: confirm order specifications including thread size, embedment depth, and load chart ratings, then lock in the commercial invoice and packing list matching gross and net weights. Next, prepare the bill of lading, certificate of origin, and applicable customs declarations for the destination port, while verifying any applicable ISO, ASTM, or EN reference markings requested by your engineering team rather than assuming unverified test reports. Careful alignment between carton labels, packing lists, and port documents keeps clearance smooth from factory dispatch to site delivery.
body.zh: 对于从中国楔形锚栓供应商采购并运往南部非洲和东非项目的买家而言，规范的包装、起订量和出口单据能有效防止运输损坏与清关延误。M10楔形锚栓和M12楔形锚栓等常规规格通常先装入彩盒或塑料袋，再放入双层瓦楞纸箱，随后用缠绕膜和打包带固定在经过熏蒸或热处理的ISPM 15木托盘上。发往德班、贝拉和蒙巴萨的海运航线建议使用防潮内衬和托盘护角，碳钢与不锈钢楔形锚栓在沿海潮湿环境或发往津巴布韦和赞比亚的内陆运输中尤其需要这类防护。作为行业常见值，起订量通常从每种规格和表面处理约500至2,000件起，整柜发货时可安排多规格拼箱。订舱前请按步骤确认订单参数，包括螺纹规格、锚固深度和载荷表数值，随后核准与毛重、净重一致的商业发票和装箱单。接着准备提单、原产地证及目的港所需的报关文件，同时核实工程团队要求的ISO、ASTM或EN参考标识，切勿轻信未经核实的检测报告。纸箱标签、装箱单与港口单据保持一致，可确保从工厂出货到现场交付清关顺畅。
